What's needed, and by when.

Classroom Management
Kids roster

Add each kid once — their classroom and attendance days feed the weekly grid below.

Weekly attendance grid

Who's expected, Monday through Friday — pick a classroom. Save a snapshot each week to keep a record you can look back on.

Drop-ins

Track kids dropping in outside their normal schedule — future dates or same-day.

Late pick-ups

Log families who pick up late, to spot patterns and charge the late fee.

Child transition

Classroom moves, graduations, and withdrawals — all in one place.

Vacation notice

Kids away on vacation — moves to archived once they're back.

New child

Kids starting soon — moves to archived once their start date arrives.

Classroom material request

Gear and supplies requested for a classroom — each room has a $100/month budget, tracked below.

Work orders

Repairs and maintenance requests — who it's for, which classroom, and where things stand.

Good to know

A running log per classroom. Each note is signed with the name chosen in "Your name" at the top. When a note stops applying, retire it: it moves to the history and can be brought back.

Settings
Closures, holidays & special events

Days the center is closed, holidays, and one-off events. A closure greys out that day on the Week Review calendar, a holiday tints it blue, and an event shows as a note on the day.

Bring in an academic calendar

Upload the calendar (a PDF, or a text / CSV file), or use the 2026–27 one we have on file. You'll see everything it found before anything is added.

Or paste a list

One per line, date first: "11/25/2026 Thanksgiving", "November 25–27, 2026 Thanksgiving Break", "12/21-25/2026 Christmas Break".

Add one
Coming up
Daily Flow rows

What each Daily Flow row asks for when something is added to it. Open a row to change it: what the entries ask for (who covers it, who is coming, extra support, or nothing), what that field is called, which list the names come from, and whether it ever has a time of day. To change the order the rows show in, drag the Daily Flow tasks up or down on the Admin tasks page (or drag a category name right on the calendar).

Other name lists

Lists of names a Daily Flow row can use instead of the staff names, such as the coaches who come for a service. One name per line.

Task categories

The groups on the Daily tasks list. Each one can have a short description that shows under its name. The Daily Flow group feeds the Daily Flow calendar, so it can't be renamed or removed.

Projects

The project names used in the Project tracker. Renaming a project also updates every task already filed under it.

Staff names

The people offered in every name list on the site: the "Your name" box, and the Person / Staff member / Requested by / Covered by lists. Add everyone who needs to be picked. Each person gets their own comment color.

Section titles & descriptions

Reword the title or the short description under it on any section of the site. Changes show everywhere as soon as you click out of the box. "Reset to original" puts the first wording back.

Classrooms

The classroom names offered in the dropdowns (material requests, Good to know). To rename a room, add the new name and remove the old one — entries already saved keep the name they were saved with.
